messages:
Hana Morales: morning folks! Hana here, starting on eng-ml today. quick blockers: MDM says 'compliance required' and my VPN cert isn't showing up. also curious who handles shuttle passes / office access. fun fact: i once taught salsa to a robotics meetup.
Lena (People Ops): welcome Hana!! :tada: your buddy is Omar. DM me your laptop serial and preferred hoodie size and i'll sort the kit. Shuttle passes handled by facilities, i'll CC them if you want one.
Omar (Eng-ML): hey Hana 44b welcome aboard. ping me your github handle and corp email and i'll add you to inference-experiments and the GPU booking calendar. For VPN, what's the client error?
Hana Morales: corp email hana.morales@redwood.com, github hanam. VPN error: "No matching certificate found". laptop serial: 7XK9LZ2031.
DevEx Bot: Quick checklist: 1) Ensure MDM enrolled; 2) Run `profiles status -type enrollment`; 3) If enrollment complete, run `sudo /usr/local/bin/reload_vpn_certs`. Reply with `reload` to trigger cert refresh.
Hana Morales: ran profiles status 4dd shows 'Enrollment: Pending - Compliance required'.
MDM Bot: Device 7XK9LZ2031 flagged for compliance: disk encryption not enabled. Please enable FileVault and reply `fv-on` once complete.
Hana Morales: enabling FileVault now 4bb will reply `fv-on` when done.
Lena (People Ops): FYI we'll mail stickers + a welcome mug. If you prefer pickup, say so. Also team lunch at 12pm Friday 35f bring a snack to share if you're in-office.
Hana Morales: fv-on. did the MDM check; still shows 'compliant: false'. Any wait time?
Omar (Eng-ML): sometimes MDM needs a restart after FileVault. Try reboot and `profiles status` again. Meanwhile i've put you on the GPU calendar for a 2h boot session tomorrow so you can run a quick model repro.
DevEx Bot: Certificate refresh scheduled for hana.morales@redwood.com. If VPN still fails after reboot, run `reload` here to trigger a manual refresh.
Hana Morales: rebooted; profiles status now shows 'Compliant'. VPN connected! thanks everyone. excited to meet the team 60a also happy to demo salsa at the next socials :dancer:
